channel.title: BusinessHub.cy — Compliance
channel.description: Latest Compliance stories from BusinessHub.cy, Cyprus Edition.

item.title: EU emissions continue to fall as clean energy gains ground
item.description: EU greenhouse gas emissions dropped by 8% in 2023, driven by a significant shift toward renewable energy and reduced coal reliance across member states.

item.title: Daily news - Nov 8, 2026
item.description: The EU's 2026 climate reports show a 1.6% drop in GHG emissions and an 11% increase in ETS revenues, highlighting the ongoing decoupling of economic growth from carbon emissions.

item.title: EU seeks nominations for stakeholder group on tokenisation standards in finance
item.description: EU authorities invite financial industry stakeholders to join the European Tokenisation Standards Group (ETSG) to shape unified standards for tokenised financial ecosystems.

item.title: Statement by President von der Leyen following her call with President Zelenskyy and ahead of her visit to the Black Sea Region, in Romania and Bulgaria
item.description: EU President von der Leyen initiates a Black Sea diplomatic mission to address escalating security threats and restore freedom of navigation for food and energy infrastructure.

item.title: The Minister of Finance of the Republic of Cyprus travels to Brussels for the Eurogroup and ECOFIN meetings of 9 November 2026
item.description: Finance Minister Makis Keravnos attends Eurogroup/ECOFIN to lobby for tax flexibility on energy and discuss the digital euro, banking risks, and tobacco tax reforms.

item.title: The Minister of Finance travels to Brussels for the Eurogroup and ECOFIN Council meetings
item.description: Cyprus Finance Minister Makis Keravnos attends Eurogroup/ECOFIN meetings to lobby for tax relief on heating oil and discuss Eurozone banking stability and digital euro progress.

item.title: Speech: Press remarks by Executive Vice-President Fitto and Commissioner Tzitzikostas on the EU Sustainable Tourism Strategy
item.description: The European Commission has launched the EU Sustainable Tourism Strategy to coordinate growth, address labor shortages, and distribute economic benefits more widely across territories.

item.title: Speech: Remarks by High Representative/Vice-President Kallas and Commissioner Kos on the 2026 Enlargement Package
item.description: The EU's 2026 Enlargement Package prioritizes four frontrunners for accession while maintaining a standstill with Turkey and halting Georgia's progress due to democratic backsliding.

item.title: Statement following meeting on prosperity talks today
item.description: International stakeholders met to refine Ukraine's post-war reconstruction framework, emphasizing EU accession reforms as the primary driver for private investment and economic stability.

item.title: Questions and answers on the Education and Skills package
item.description: The European Commission has launched an Education and Skills package to combat declining basic skills, teacher shortages, and digital risks through AI literacy and structural reforms.

item.title: CBC Macroeconomic Forecasts for the Cyprus Economy
item.description: The Central Bank of Cyprus has released its 2026–2028 macroeconomic forecasts, providing critical projections for GDP growth, inflation, and employment to guide medium-term business planning.

item.title: Statement by the Ministry of Foreign Affairs on the illegal visit of the Turkish Foreign Minister to the occupied areas
item.description: Cyprus condemns Turkish Foreign Minister Hakan Fidan's visit to occupied areas, labeling it a breach of international law and UN resolutions.

item.title: Warning regarding unregulated entities (Aug 14)
item.description: CySEC has blacklisted nine unauthorized investment websites, including 'cypriantrustbank.com', warning professionals and investors to verify licenses via its official portal.

item.title: Warning regarding unregulated entities (Sept 04)
item.description: CySEC has blacklisted nine websites for providing investment and crypto-asset services without the necessary legal authorizations in Cyprus.

item.title: €525 million investment set to drive new generation of European chip design companies
item.description: The EU has launched the €525 million European Chip Design Platform (EuroCDP) to provide funding, tools, and manufacturing access to semiconductor start-ups and SMEs.

item.title: Commission launches Education and Skills package to tackle declining basic skills, rapid digital change and teacher shortages
item.description: The European Commission has launched an Education and Skills package to improve basic skills, AI literacy, and vocational training across Member States including Cyprus.

item.title: Commission disburses €4.36 billion to Ukraine under the €90 billion Ukraine Support Loan
item.description: The European Commission has disbursed €4.36 billion to Ukraine for budget support and defense, contingent on tax reforms and customs modernization.

item.title: Euro area unemployment at 6.5%
item.description: Euro area unemployment held steady at 6.5% in September 2026, though rates remain higher than the previous year, with a slight uptick in youth and male unemployment.

item.title: France’s Financial Intelligence Unit (Tracfin) Hosts 400 EG Representatives from Around the Globe
item.description: Global FIUs meet in Paris for the 30th Egmont Plenary to discuss 'The Next Generation FIU' and digital/environmental transitions in AML/CFT.

item.title: Webinar – Enabling the evidential use of intelligence material
item.description: A webinar by the Egmont Group and IAP explores strategies for converting financial intelligence into admissible evidence for criminal proceedings.

item.title: The Global FIU Leadership Conference – “Back to the Future” taking place October 14–15, 2025
item.description: The Global FIU Leadership Conference, focusing on AI and digital disruption, will take place in October 2025 for FIU heads to discuss the evolving role of financial intelligence.

item.title: Luxembourg’s FIU (CRF) hosts the 30th anniversary of the Egmont Group at this year’s Plenary
item.description: The 30th Egmont Group Plenary in Luxembourg focuses on the future of international FIU coordination and intelligence sharing for AML/CFT over the next decade.

item.title: FIC Workshop in Bangkok Unites FIUs and Customs Authorities Across Asia-Pacific and Eurasia to Strengthen Joint Action Against Financial Crime
item.description: The Egmont Group, ECOFEL, and WCO hosted a regional workshop in Bangkok to enhance FIU-Customs collaboration against trade-based money laundering and financial crime.

item.title: Regional Workshop in Riyadh Advances FIU, Law Enforcement, and Prosecutor Collaboration Across MENA
item.description: The Egmont Group's ECOFEL held a workshop in Riyadh to enhance inter-agency cooperation and financial intelligence sharing across the MENA region to combat money laundering and terrorism financing.

item.title: Investigating Professional Money Laundering, Underground Banking, and the Use of Hawala and Other Similar Service Providers
item.description: New FATF report warns of the scale of professional money laundering through underground banking and Hawala, involving schemes exceeding €500 million.

item.title: Risks of Gaming and Gambling
item.description: FATF highlights evolving money laundering and terrorist financing risks in the increasingly digital and interconnected global gaming and gambling sectors.

item.title: FATF Mutual Evaluation Report of Türkiye 2026
item.description: The 2026 FATF report highlights Türkiye's strengthened AML/CFT framework while urging improvements in cross-border asset recovery and investigations into high-risk predicate offenses.

item.title: FATF/APG Mutual Evaluation Report of Canada 2026
item.description: FATF's 2026 evaluation of Canada highlights progress in beneficial ownership transparency but identifies significant gaps in supervision, prosecution of complex money laundering, and international cooperation timelines.

item.title: Outcomes FATF Plenary, 28-30 October 2026
item.description: FATF introduces accelerated virtual asset enforcement and removes four countries, including Monaco and Bulgaria, from its 'grey list' during the October 2026 plenary.

item.title: Launch of targeted review process to accelerate global implementation of FATF Standards relating to virtual assets
item.description: The FATF is launching a targeted review of jurisdictions with significant crypto activity to accelerate global compliance with virtual asset and VASP standards.

item.title: Combating End-to-End Illicit Financial Flows Linked to Scam Compounds: Applying the FATF Toolkit to the Fraud Epidemic
item.description: FATF releases a new strategic framework to combat the industrialised financial flows of global scam compounds, emphasizing cross-border disruption and infrastructure targeting.

item.title: ESMA analysis shows continued growth in cross-border investment services
item.description: ESMA reports a significant surge in cross-border investment activity, with Cyprus maintaining its status as the leading hub for EU passporting firms.

item.title: ESMA's third Sanctions Report highlights the need for greater convergence in enforcement
item.description: ESMA’s 2025 Sanctions Report reveals uneven enforcement across the EEA, signaling an upcoming push for harmonized penalties and increased supervisory pressure in smaller jurisdictions like Cyprus.

item.title: ESMA updates its manual on transparency with new guidance for OTC derivatives and tick-size regime
item.description: ESMA has updated its transparency manual, introducing new guidance for OTC derivatives reporting and the tick-size regime to enhance EU market data consistency.

item.title: One year to go for T+1 settlement: the regulatory framework is complete, now let’s make it happen
item.description: The EU sets October 11, 2027, as the official date for transitioning to T+1 settlement, requiring urgent technical and operational preparations from market participants.

item.title: ESMA finalises the review of guidelines on the delay in disclosure of inside information
item.description: ESMA has updated its guidelines on delaying the disclosure of inside information, adding five new legitimate interests while removing outdated provisions to align with new EU regulations.

item.title: New Q&As available
item.description: ESMA has released updated Q&A guidance regarding Crowdfunding, MiCA, and EMIR frameworks to ensure harmonized regulatory implementation across the EU.

item.title: ESMA specifies requirements to facilitate safe use of post-trade risk reduction services
item.description: ESMA has released final draft RTS under EMIR 3, detailing exemptions from the clearing obligation for specific post-trade risk reduction (PTRR) services to enhance market resilience.

item.title: ESMA streamlines several Q&As as part of simplification efforts
item.description: ESMA has streamlined its Q&A documents by removing obsolete and redundant guidance to align with current legislative frameworks.

item.title: ESMA proposes simpler EU Taxonomy reporting
item.description: ESMA has proposed technical changes to simplify EU Taxonomy reporting, focusing on narrowing OpEx KPIs and streamlining group disclosures to reduce administrative burdens.

item.title: ESMA publishes latest edition of its newsletter
item.description: ESMA's latest newsletter outlines the 2027 work programme, the transition to T+1 settlement, and critical updates to MiCA and digital innovation supervision.

item.title: An SME Strategy for a sustainable and digital Europe
item.description: The European Commission has launched a comprehensive strategy to transition SMEs towards sustainability and digitalization, emphasizing their role as the backbone of the EU economy.

item.title: Press Release - 312 Management Companies and Undertakings of Collective Investments
item.description: CySEC reports a slight contraction in the collective investment sector for Q4 2025, with Assets Under Management dipping to €11.2 billion across 312 supervised entities.

item.title: Investors Compensation Fund - Invitation for expressions of interest for the provision of execution and custody services
item.description: The Investors Compensation Fund (ICF) is seeking qualified financial institutions to provide execution and custody services for its government bond and treasury investments.

item.title: Dissolution and liquidation of RAIF SMART FUSION V.C.I.C. LTD
item.description: CySEC announces the initiation of dissolution and liquidation procedures for SMART FUSION V.C.I.C. LTD, a Registered Alternative Investment Fund managed by KENDRIS CAPITAL LIMITED.

item.title: Press Release - CySEC’s Successful Contribution to the Cyprus Presidency of the Council of the EU
item.description: CySEC successfully concluded its technical leadership role during the Cyprus Presidency of the EU Council, shaping key financial regulations like MISP, SFDR revision, and FIDA.

item.title: Announcement on the end of the MiCA Regulation transitional period and warning to the public
item.description: CySEC reminds investors and firms that the MiCA transitional period has ended, mandating that all crypto-asset services must now strictly comply with EU Regulation 2023/1114.

item.title: PRACTICAL GUIDE Whistleblowing
item.description: CySEC has released a Practical Guide to assist whistleblowers and regulated entities in reporting violations of Union and National law within the financial sector.

item.title: Dissolution and liquidation of THREE LIONS REAL ESTATE RAIF V.C.I.C. PUBLIC LTD
item.description: Three Lions Real Estate RAIF has initiated dissolution and liquidation procedures, as announced by CySEC following notification from its manager, Consulco Capital.

item.title: Press Release - CySEC welcomes ESMA’s follow-up Peer Review Report on the supervision of cross-border activities of investment firms
item.description: ESMA’s follow-up report praises CySEC for significantly strengthening its supervision and enforcement of investment firms operating cross-border, citing increased resources and improved risk frameworks.
